name: Article → Trial links (sample)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial) RETURN a.pmid, a.title, t.nct_id LIMIT 10

name: Cancer articles → Trial interventions
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE m.name = 'Neoplasms' RETURN i.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Diabetes articles → Trial interventions
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE m.name = 'Diabetes Mellitus' RETURN i.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Heart disease articles → Trial adverse events
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) WHERE m.name = 'Heart Diseases' RETURN ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Aspirin articles → Trials
cypher: MATCH (c:Chemical)<-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE c.name = 'Aspirin' RETURN t.nct_id, a.title LIMIT 10

name: Metformin articles → Trial adverse events

name: Trial sites for cancer research
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) WHERE m.name = 'Neoplasms' RETURN s.country, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: NCI-funded articles → Trial interventions
